Description: Purchase order headers (SAP EKKO). EBELN PO number, BUKRS company code, LIFNR vendor, BEDAT PO date (dd.mm.yyyy), NETWR_TOTAL sum of line net values excluding deleted lines, EKGRP purchasing group.

PO lines (SAP EKPO). MENGE ordered quantity in BSTME (order unit); NETPR net price per PEINH units (price unit); NETWR = MENGE x NETPR / PEINH; UEBTO over-delivery tolerance % (blank = 0); ELIKZ delivery completed; EREKZ final invoice posted; LOEKZ deletion indicator (L); STATUS Open or Closed; KNTTP account assignment (A asset, K cost centre, P project); PSTYP D = service item; CHANGE_NOTE last buyer note.

Goods receipts and service entries (SAP MSEG). BWART 101 receipt, 102 reversal of a 101, 122 return to vendor; REF_MBLNR / REF_ZEILE point to the receipt a 102 or 122 relates to. ERFMG / ERFME quantity and unit as entered at the gate or site, which may differ from the PO order unit. WB_SLIP weighbridge slip for bulk loads. BUDAT posting date.

Vendor invoices parked and awaiting match (SAP RBKP). BELNR invoice document, XBLNR vendor's invoice number, BLDAT invoice date as printed, BUDAT posting date, PARKED_ON timestamp (IST unless marked Z for UTC), RMWWR gross amount including GST, WMWST1 GST amount, REF_PO the PO numbers quoted, ATTACHMENT the invoice image where one was received.

Invoice lines as captured from the vendor invoice (SAP RSEG). EBELN / EBELP the PO and item(s) the vendor quoted (one line can quote two items); MENGE and MEINS quantity and unit as billed; UNIT_PRICE per billed unit; WRBTR line net amount; TAX_PCT and TAX_AMT GST on the line.

Invoices already posted against the same PO lines. MENGE in the PO order unit, WRBTR net amount, FINAL_INVOICE X when the vendor marked it final, STATUS Posted or Reversed (reversed invoices take no quantity).
Material master (SAP MARA). MEINS base unit; CATEGORY bulk, manufactured, service or capex as used by the variance policy; BSTME_DEFAULT usual order unit; HSN_SAC and GST_PCT.
Alternative units per material (SAP MARM). UMREZ base units (MEINS) equal UMREN alternative units (MEINH). Example: MEINH BAG, UMREZ 50, UMREN 1, MEINS KG means 1 BAG = 50 KG for that material.
Named approvers for escalations, and for the release of a stopped invoice, by trigger, value band, category and plant. LEVEL 3 is the most senior (CFO office), 1 the least (Plant accounts head).
Vendors referenced by the POs and invoices (SAP LFA1 extract).

Exact matches; matches after unit conversion; several partial receipts on one PO line; receipt reversals and returns, some posted after the invoice was parked; invoice lines that cover two PO lines; invoices that cover more than one PO; price variance only, inside and above tolerance; quantity variance only; price and quantity variance together; tolerances that differ by value band and category; receipt, PO and invoice units that differ, including some that do not reconcile once converted; receipts above the ordered quantity; invoices against closed PO lines; invoices with no goods receipt; repeated vendor invoice numbers; quantities above what remains after earlier invoices; PO cumulative variance above the PO limit while each line is inside tolerance; records that combine two of these; and records that look irregular but are in order.
